about.subtitle: SoftWeb is a modern IT studio bridging high-end aesthetics with enterprise engineering.
about.manifestoText1: Every project is a strategic asset for SoftWeb. We reject slow page-builders in favor of hand-crafted Next.js and TypeScript architecture.
about.manifestoText2: Whether a landing page, corporate platform, online store, or SaaS software — our goal is to position your brand as a market leader.
about.pillar1Desc: Engineered from scratch line-by-line without slow page builders.
